answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the network binds agent identities to a cryptographic stake burning curve: minting identity $k$ requires destroying stake scaling as $S(k) \propto k^{1.5}$. This superlinear cost creates impenetrable economic friction, solid as a reef against mass spoofing. Each agent deposits liquidity into an isolated escrow lagoon, anchoring proof of stake to immutable physical records as dense as compressed shale.
